teasers.text: Netflix ~800 naukriyan kaatne ki taiyari mein

stories.title: DMart Q2 Profit Rises [[8.5%]] to [[₹743 Cr]]
stories.line: Revenue 17.8% badhkar ₹19,644 Cr, par margin 7.3% se 7.1% pe phisla.

stories.title: Brokerages Split on TCS: [[₹1,800]] to [[₹2,630]]
stories.line: Nomura bola Buy @ ₹2,630, Jefferies bola Underperform @ ₹1,800. Share 5%+ uchla.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Brace for an [[AI Crisis]] Within [[12 Months]]
stories.line: Axios: insiders ko 6 se 12 mahine mein bade AI incident ka darr. Banks, internet, power top worry.

stories.title: Netflix May Cut [[~5%]] of Staff, Nearly [[800 Jobs]]
stories.line: ~16,000 mein se ~800 naukriyan. Netflix ne abhi tak confirm nahi kiya.

stories.title: Nat Habit Raises [[₹142 Cr]] in Series C
stories.line: Trident Growth Partners ne lead kiya. Plan: 3 saal mein 20,000 se 2 lakh stores.

stories.title: Anand Rathi AUM Crosses [[₹1.08 Lakh Cr]]
stories.line: AUM 18% up, adjusted profit 22% badhkar ₹121.9 Cr. ₹4 dividend bhi.

stories.title: Peak XV Sells [[₹47 Cr]] of Awfis Shares
stories.line: 19.2 lakh shares @ ₹245 bech diye: 3.24% stake mein se 2.68% nikal liya.

stories.title: NeoGrowth Raises [[₹85 Cr]] for MSME Loans
stories.line: FMO aur LeapFrog se paisa aaya. Target: loan book ~₹3,000 Cr tak.

stories.title: Axis AMC Launches SIF With [[₹10 Lakh]] Minimum
stories.line: Accelerate SIF: mutual fund aur PMS ke beech ki nayi category, bade investors ke liye.

recap: Peak XV sells ₹47 Cr Awfis stake
